package.description: Windows tray app for viewing local Codex usage limits.

en-US.description: Windows tray app for viewing local Codex usage limits.
en-US.longDescription: A small, privacy-friendly Windows tray application that reads local Codex usage and task-state metadata. It displays weekly and rolling five-hour limits through widgets, a tray icon and a multi-display taskbar indicator without account credentials, analytics, or telemetry.
en-US.name: Codex Usage Meter for Windows
